note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Needs the .NET 8 runtime for this recording only; prepare installs it with winget when missing and teardown removes it again. Re-read the support dates on the lifecycle page on the day (the narration quotes them; on 22 Nov 2026 it showed 11/10/2026 for .NET 8 and 9, 11/14/2028 for .NET 10, and a .NET 11 row at the top).
prepare: if (-not ((dotnet --list-runtimes) -match 'Microsoft\.NETCore\.App 8\.')) { winget install --id Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.8 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements; 'installed by prepare' | Set-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mg-ep10-net8-runtime.marker') }  # .NET 8 runtime only for this recording (support ended 10 Nov 2026)

screens.name: lifecycle
steps: Scroll to the table; the first row is .NET 11 (start 11/10/2026, no end date), pass it
Point at .NET 10 and its end date 11/14/2028 (the row has no (LTS) label on this page; the narration takes LTS from the .NET support policy)

screens.name: tests
screens.note: Expected: one line per test app, (net8.0|x64) passed and (net10.0|x64) passed, then the summary total: 53, failed: 0, succeeded: 53, skipped: 0. Per-target counts are not printed, and the narration does not quote them.

teardown: $m = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mg-ep10-net8-runtime.marker'; if (Test-Path $m) { winget uninstall --id Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.8 -e --silent; Remove-Item $m }
needs: dotnet8-runtime (installed by prepare, removed by teardown)
